newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Atmos Energy rating raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Atmos Energy rating raised.

text.p: -- Edward Jones said it raised its rating on Atmos Energy Corp to strong buy from buy. It also raised its rating on United Cities Gas Co to buy from hold.
-- Atmos' merger with United Cities will create cost savings and revenue growth potential, Edward Jones said.

-- Investor with a higher risk tolerance can buy United Cities at an eight percent discount to Atmos, potentially earning a 12-month total return of 30 percent plus, Edward Jones noted, which estimates the probability of the merger succeeding at 90 percent.
-- Atmos was up 1/8 at 24-1/8 and United Cities was unchanged at 23.
